entities.summary: Nanni Cagnone is an Italian poet, novelist, essayist and playwright. He debuted as a poet in 1954 and since then has written several books, mostly poetry but also plays, tales and novels, theoretical essays and aphorisms, from The Disabled Youth (1967) to The Oslo Lecture (2008). He is the brother of the artist Angelo Cagnone, and is married to Sandra Holt. Currently lives in Bomarzo.
